strategies.name: Trend + Breakout Swing
strategies.hypothesis: Stocks in an uptrend that break their 20-day high on above-average volume, while outperforming NIFTY, tend to continue for a few weeks. Only trade when the index itself is in an uptrend.

score: +2 price > 50-day SMA > 200-day SMA (uptrend); -2 if the reverse
+1 21-day SMA crossed above 50-day within 4 bars; -1 if crossed below
+1 RSI(14) between 50 and 70; -1 if between 30 and 45
+2 close above previous 20-day high with volume > 1.5x 20-day average; -2 for a 20-day low
+1 3-month return beats NIFTY; -1 if it lags
rules.entry: score >= +5 AND index regime BULL (or SIDEWAYS with score >= +6); no news-risk words in last 3 days
rules.exit: score <= -5 (SELL), stop 2xATR below entry, target 3xATR above, trailing stop 4% once up 5%, time exit 20 bars, regime turns BEAR
rules.sizing: 1% of equity at risk between entry and stop; <= 25% of equity; <= 5% of 20-day volume; halve size when index 20-day vol > 25%

failure_modes: whipsaw in sideways markets (false breakouts)
gap-downs through the stop (fill worse than stop)
regime filter is slow: late entries after long rallies
news shocks; only headline words are screened

strategies.name: 21 / 50 SMA Crossover
strategies.universe: NIFTY 50 index (spot as proxy for the future)
strategies.hypothesis: When the 21-day average crosses above the 50-day, a trend has started; exit when it crosses back.
failure_modes: late entries and exits in choppy markets
long flat periods
gives back most of a trend

backtest.fees_note: Indian statutory charges + brokerage per fill; slippage applied; see costs.py verification status

strategies.name: NIFTY Options: Regime Debit Spreads
strategies.universe: NIFTY weekly options (modeled prices until a quote feed exists)
strategies.hypothesis: In a confirmed downtrend with weak momentum, a defined-risk put spread captures continuation with capped loss; mirror for confirmed breakouts in uptrends.

rules.entry: BEAR + close<SMA50 + RSI<45 -> buy ATM put / sell put 200 pts lower; BULL + 20-day breakout -> call spread
rules.exit: +50% of max profit, -50% of debit, 2 days to expiry, or regime flip
rules.sizing: max loss (known in advance) <= 3% of account equity, whole lots only; max 2 open spreads (max 6% total at risk)

failure_modes: prices are Black-Scholes MODELED, not quotes: real fills differ (spreads, skew)
gap moves through the short strike cap the gain
IV crush after events
lot-size / expiry rules must be verified

strategies.name: Volatility Trend ATR
strategies.hypothesis: ATR expansion after a quiet period marks the start of an intraday trend; enter with the expansion, exit on ATR contraction or a 1.5xATR trailing stop.

rules.entry: close > VWAP and ATR(14) rises above 1.3x its 20-bar median, in the direction of the 20-bar slope

failure_modes: needs intraday data (not available yet)
fake expansions at open
square-off costs

strategies.name: Nifty 50 Short Straddle with Stop-loss
strategies.hypothesis: Selling the ATM straddle collects time decay on quiet days; per-leg stop-loss at 30% of premium limits blow-ups.

rules.exit: each leg: stop at +30% premium; both: 15:10 square-off

failure_modes: gap moves and event days: losses far beyond the credit
requires live option chain and margin model
SEBI lot-size and margin rules
strategies.blocked_by: live option chain + margin model + proven paper record

strategies.name: Nifty Breakout Precision
strategies.hypothesis: A break of the first-hour range on NIFTY futures, in the direction of the daily trend, continues into the afternoon.

rules.entry: break of 09:15-10:15 range with volume; one re-entry after a stop

failure_modes: range-bound days
needs intraday futures data

strategies.name: Nifty Channel Surge (futures)
strategies.hypothesis: A close outside a 20-day Donchian channel starts a positional move; ride it with a 2xATR trailing stop.
failure_modes: whipsaws
rollover costs
strategies.blocked_by: can be backtested on NIFTY spot proxy now; futures basis not modelled

strategies.name: Nifty ETF vs Gold ETF pair
strategies.hypothesis: The 60-day normalised return spread between NIFTYBEES and GOLDBEES mean-reverts; buy the laggard when the spread z-score < -2, exit at 0.

rules.sizing: equal rupee legs, long only (no ETF shorting in delivery)

failure_modes: structural regime shifts (gold rally with equity crash)
spread can widen for months
strategies.blocked_by: needs GOLDBEES history download (available via Yahoo) - queued for backtest

note: Backtest returns are historical, after modelled costs; they are not expected future profits.
